message.content:
This portrait-oriented editorial cover features a black-and-white close-up photograph of a man's face and upper torso against a dark, featureless background. The man has short, dark hair, dark eyes, and a neutral expression. He wears a light-colored, collared shirt. His face is the central focus, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center.

Large, white, capital letters spell "TEMPO" across the top, partially obscured by a solid red rectangular block in the upper left. A smaller red circle with an eye-like graphic is on the left, next to the white text "EDISI KHUSUS". Below this, the man's name "OEI TJOE TAT" is written in bold, white, capital letters, with each word underlined by a thick red horizontal bar. At the bottom, cursive red text reads "Penyambung lidah Bung Karno".

Small white text at the top right includes "81" and "INDONESIA BERDAULAT ADIL DAN MAKMUR". At the bottom right, small white text indicates dates, price, website, and ISSN, next to a barcode and a QR code.
